faq.a: Rishab Gautam (rishabnotfound) is a software developer and entrepreneur from Delhi, India, born 22 January 2007. He is the Co-Founder and Technical Lead at Nept Cloud and ships production-grade infrastructure — including Layla, Syella, MakimaKey, DeltaSys, Commitify and the world's first Lua + nginx HLS proxy — used by hundreds of thousands of people. He contributes upstream to PreMiD and FMHY.

Rishab builds production-grade developer infrastructure end-to-end: Layla (web-push platform serving ~470k subscribers across 150–200 sites), Syella (cross-platform terminal that competes with MobaXterm and Termius), MakimaKey (fully-offline encrypted Android TOTP authenticator), DeltaSys (browser-based VPS control plane), Commitify (GitHub contribution automation used by hundreds), MongoSync (MongoDB admin surface), RezePlayer (HLS/MP4 video engine), and Maki-HLS-Proxy (the world's first HLS proxy in Lua + nginx).
Rishab is based in Delhi, India. He is studying for a BS in Data Science and Applications at IIT Madras and a BCA at Manipal University Jaipur.
You can reach Rishab at contact@rishab.cv, or on GitHub, LinkedIn, X (Twitter), Instagram and Discord as @rishabnotfound.

faq.q: What open-source projects has Rishab contributed to?
faq.a: Rishab has merged pull requests to PreMiD Activities and FMHY, including a Discord Rich Presence integration (PreMiD #9391) and PWA support (FMHY #4094).
